title: Keyword search can't read “FR”
story: The answer sits in a table that writes “FR” and “Nat.”, never “France” or “national”. Keyword search finds nothing and declines; text and visual search find the table, and the reranker lifts it to rank 2.

title: Visual search goes straight to the table
story: Keyword search ranks the answer page 11th and declines. Every embedding method ranks it first, and hybrid + rerank fills the top 3 with complete-answer pages.

title: The look-alike page trap
story: Another page reports a similar statistic (the “anchored” AROP rate). Single methods and plain hybrid retrieve it and answer confidently wrong; only the reranker surfaces the right page, giving 16.5% and 16.2%.

title: Evidence spread over two pages
story: Corporate profits are on one page and the labour share on another. Visual and hybrid search retrieve both, so the answer can cite each figure to its own page.

title: Two countries, two pages
story: Greece and Portugal are reported on different pages. Keyword search finds neither and declines; hybrid + rerank retrieves both and answers with both exact figures.

title: Honest failure: an ambiguous question
story: Visual search finds the right page at rank 2, yet every answer is graded wrong: the model reads “percentage of vacancies” as the vacancy rate, while the reference means each sector's share of all vacancies. Retrieval is not the whole job.
